light_anchor_e.text: The first time an ally falls, it gets back up at once with 25 % HP. Once per battle for the whole team, even if this Ovaling has already fallen.

light_anchor_g.name: Soul Anchor
light_anchor_g.text: The first time an ally falls, it gets back up at once with 30 % HP. Once per battle for the whole team, even if this Ovaling has already fallen.

light_banner_e.name: Banner Bearer
light_banner_e.text: While it is alive, the whole team has 5 % more attack and 5 % more defense.

light_beacon_e.name: Lighthouse
light_beacon_e.text: While it has more than 50 % HP, enemy single-target attacks go to it, as with Taunt. It then takes 20 % less damage.

light_beacon_r.name: Lighthouse
light_beacon_r.text: While it has more than 70 % HP, enemy single-target attacks go to it, as with Taunt. It then takes 20 % less damage.

light_bequest_g.name: Legacy
light_bequest_g.text: When it falls, it heals all living allies by 35 % of their max HP and removes all their debuffs. Anything above full HP becomes a shield. Once per battle.

light_bequest_r.name: Legacy
light_bequest_r.text: When it falls, it heals all living allies by 25 % of their max HP and removes all their debuffs. Anything above full HP becomes a shield. Once per battle.

light_boost_e.name: Healing Power
light_boost_e.text: Heals and shields from this Ovaling are 15 % stronger.

light_boost_n.name: Healing Power
light_boost_n.text: Heals and shields from this Ovaling are 7 % stronger.

light_breath_n.name: Second Breath
light_breath_n.text: At the start of its turn, it heals itself by 8 % of the HP it lost since its last turn.

light_catch_n.name: Catching Light
light_catch_n.text: When an Ovaling on the team survives a hit of at least 15 % of its HP, it gets a shield of 5 % of its HP at once.

light_chorus_g.name: Choir of Light
light_chorus_g.text: While it is alive, the whole team deals 3 % more damage for each other living ally, up to 4.

light_circle_g.name: Circle of Protection
light_circle_g.text: At the start of every battle, the whole team gets a shield of 20 % of max HP.

light_circle_r.name: Circle of Protection
light_circle_r.text: At the start of every battle, the whole team gets a shield of 5 % of max HP.

light_clarity_r.name: Clear Light
light_clarity_r.text: While it is alive, new debuffs on its team last 1 turn shorter, at least 1 turn, and are a quarter weaker.

light_crown_g.name: Sun Crown
light_crown_g.text: On each of its turns in which it acts, the ally with the least HP gets a shield of 2 % of its HP and Block Debuffs for 1 turn.

light_crystal_g.name: Crystal Skin
light_crystal_g.text: While it is alive, critical hits against its team deal 40 % less bonus damage.

light_crystal_r.name: Crystal Skin
light_crystal_r.text: While it is alive, critical hits against its team deal 25 % less bonus damage.

light_dawn_n.name: First Light
light_dawn_n.text: At the start of the battle and of every new wave, it already has 15 % turn meter.

light_defer_e.name: Deferral
light_defer_e.text: 15 % of every direct hit only arrives at the start of its next turn, and only three quarters of that. If its damage reduction is almost full, less is dropped.

light_dome_n.name: Dome
light_dome_n.text: While it is alive, the team takes 15 % less damage from attacks that hit several targets.

light_echo_r.name: Echo
light_echo_r.text: When an ally uses an ability with a cooldown, it gets 10 % turn meter.

light_forewarn_n.name: Forewarning
light_forewarn_n.text: While it is alive, the first attack of each enemy deals 8 % less damage to the team. This starts over on every 3rd turn of its own.

light_glare_e.name: Glare
light_glare_e.text: If an enemy hits someone on the team who then has less than 50 % HP, that enemy has 25 % less attack until the end of its next turn.

light_glimpse_n.name: Silver Lining
light_glimpse_n.text: The first time an Ovaling on the team drops below 50 % HP, it is healed at once by 8 % of its max HP. Once per Ovaling and battle.

light_heal_e.name: Warm Light
light_heal_e.text: Heals all allies by 0.8 % at the start of its turn.

light_heal_g.name: Warm Light
light_heal_g.text: Heals all allies by 1.1 % at the start of its turn.

light_heal_n.name: Warm Light
light_heal_n.text: Heals all allies by 0.3 % at the start of its turn.

light_hourglass_g.name: Hourglass
light_hourglass_g.text: When its HP drops below 25 %, it turns back time once per battle: it gets back 125 % of the HP lost since the start of its last turn, and new debuffs vanish. This also saves it from falling, but then counts as a revive.

light_lead_g.name: Guiding Light
light_lead_g.text: All allies get Crit Chance +24 percentage points while this Ovaling is alive.

light_lead_r.name: Guiding Light
light_lead_r.text: All allies get Crit Chance +10 percentage points while this Ovaling is alive.

light_linger_e.name: Lasting Light
light_linger_e.text: Buffs from abilities last 3 turns longer on its team. Not for Unkillable, Taunt, Spark of Life and Block Debuffs.

light_mirror_r.name: Mirror Gleam
light_mirror_r.text: While it is alive, every enemy debuff on its team has a 20 % chance to bounce off and hit the sender.

light_painlimit_e.name: Pain Limit
light_painlimit_e.text: Of any damage above 10 % of its max HP, only half gets through.

light_phalanx_n.name: Phalanx
light_phalanx_n.text: While everyone on the team is alive, the whole team takes 4 % less damage.

light_phoenix_e.name: Phoenix Ember
light_phoenix_e.text: Once per battle, it survives lethal damage with 14 % HP and loses all debuffs. This counts as a revive.

light_phoenix_g.name: Phoenix Ember
light_phoenix_g.text: Once per battle, it survives lethal damage with 22 % HP and loses all debuffs. This counts as a revive.

light_pulse_e.name: Light Pulse
light_pulse_e.text: After every 3rd turn of its own in which it acts, all other allies get 20 % turn meter.

light_purge_g.name: Light Bath
light_purge_g.text: On each of its turns in which it acts, it removes one debuff each from up to 5 allies, the longest first. Each removal heals the target by 6 % of its max HP. Stun stays.

light_purge_r.name: Light Bath
light_purge_r.text: On each of its turns in which it acts, it removes one debuff from the ally with the most debuffs. Each removal heals the target by 6 % of its max HP. Stun stays.

light_resist_g.name: Pure Heart
light_resist_g.text: All allies have a 75 % chance to resist a harmful effect.

light_resist_n.name: Pure Heart
light_resist_n.text: All allies have a 25 % chance to resist a harmful effect.

light_resist_r.name: Pure Heart
light_resist_r.text: All allies have a 40 % chance to resist a harmful effect.

light_scale_e.name: Scales
light_scale_e.text: At the start of its turn, the HP of allies below the team average moves 4 % closer to it. Those above give up half as much, and no one falls from it.

light_shield_e.name: Shielded Start
light_shield_e.text: Starts every battle with a shield of 34 %.

light_shield_g.name: Shielded Start
light_shield_g.text: Starts every battle with a shield of 45 %.

light_shield_n.name: Shielded Start
light_shield_n.text: Starts every battle with a shield of 20 %.

light_shield_r.name: Shielded Start
light_shield_r.text: Starts every battle with a shield of 26 %.

light_shoulder_r.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
light_shoulder_r.text: After each of its abilities, there is a 35 % chance that the ally with the highest attack joins in with a basic attack at 70 % strength.

light_spark_e.name: Light Spark
light_spark_e.text: After its own critical hit, heals the whole team by 4 % of their max HP.

light_spark_n.name: Light Spark
light_spark_n.text: After its own critical hit, heals the whole team by 2 % of their max HP.

light_stand_e.name: Back to the Wall
light_stand_e.text: Below 30 % HP: defense +80 %.

light_stand_r.name: Back to the Wall
light_stand_r.text: Below 30 % HP: defense +60 %.

light_starhour_g.name: Star Hour
light_starhour_g.text: On every 5th turn of its team, all other allies attack the enemy with the least HP at once with a basic attack at 20 % strength.

light_sundial_g.name: Sundial
light_sundial_g.text: On each of its own turns, there is a 75 % chance that the longest running cooldown on the team gets 1 turn shorter. Each ability gets at most 1 turn faster per use.

light_sundial_r.name: Sundial
light_sundial_r.text: On each of its own turns, there is a 50 % chance that the longest running cooldown on the team gets 1 turn shorter. Each ability gets at most 1 turn faster per use.

light_sunrun_g.name: Sunpath
light_sunrun_g.text: After each of its turns in which it acts, the ally with the lowest turn meter gets 35 % turn meter.

light_tailwind_n.name: Updraft
light_tailwind_n.text: Permanently 3 % more speed.

light_tailwind_r.name: Updraft
light_tailwind_r.text: Permanently 4 % more speed.

light_tide_n.name: Tidal Light
light_tide_n.text: Alternates at the start of its turns: the whole team gets 4 % more attack for 1 turn, the next time 4 % less damage for 1 turn.

light_tough_r.name: Hardening
light_tough_r.text: Every hit it takes gives it 1 % less damage taken until the battle ends, at most 5 times.

light_watch_e.name: Watchful Eye
light_watch_e.text: When an ally below 50 % HP takes a direct hit, it catches 50 % of it and only feels a quarter of that itself, as long as it has over 50 % HP.

light_watch_r.name: Watchful Eye
light_watch_r.text: When an ally below 50 % HP takes a direct hit, it catches 40 % of it and only feels a quarter of that itself, as long as it has over 50 % HP.

shadow_ambush_n.name: Raid
shadow_ambush_n.text: Its first attack in every wave deals 35 % more damage, and its first hit is a sure crit.

shadow_axe_e.name: Last Cut
shadow_axe_e.text: If a normal enemy drops below 20 % HP from its hit, it falls at once. Bosses do not fall, but below 20 % HP they take 100 % more damage from it.

shadow_blades_g.name: Blade Whirl
shadow_blades_g.text: Each of its damaging moves then hits every target once more at 25 % of the strength of one hit, without effects.

shadow_bloodprice_n.name: Blood Price
shadow_bloodprice_n.text: Each of its damaging moves costs it 3 % of its max HP and deals 40 % more damage. If it has too little HP, it pays nothing and gets nothing.

shadow_chase_n.name: Follow-Up
shadow_chase_n.text: If one of its moves lands at least one crit, it then gets 15 % turn meter.

shadow_counter_e.name: Retaliation
shadow_counter_e.text: 55 % chance to strike back when hit.

shadow_counter_n.name: Retaliation
shadow_counter_n.text: 22 % chance to strike back when hit.

shadow_counter_r.name: Retaliation
shadow_counter_r.text: 35 % chance to strike back when hit.

shadow_crit_e.name: Predator's Eye
shadow_crit_e.text: Crit Chance +32 percentage points.

shadow_crit_g.name: Predator's Eye
shadow_crit_g.text: Crit Chance +50 percentage points.

shadow_crit_n.name: Predator's Eye
shadow_crit_n.text: Crit Chance +11 percentage points.

shadow_deathcurse_r.name: Death Curse
shadow_deathcurse_r.text: When it falls, or an ally falls while it is alive, the one who defeated them gets 30 % less attack and 30 % less defense for 3 turns.

shadow_decoy_r.name: Mirage
shadow_decoy_r.text: At the start of the battle and after every 30 turns of its own, a decoy is ready for the team, at most one. It catches the next single-target attack of an enemy, effects included. An unused one fades when the wave changes.

shadow_doom_g.name: Doom Clock
shadow_doom_g.text: Its hit starts a clock on the target. After 3 turns of the target, it hits for 30 % of the damage it dealt to it since then, at most 25 % of max HP. Then the next hit starts a new clock.

shadow_echo_g.name: Shadow Echo
shadow_echo_g.text: After each of its damaging moves, 40 % chance: it hits the same targets again at once at half strength, without effects.

shadow_edge_g.name: Keen Edge
shadow_edge_g.text: Crit Damage +55 percentage points.

shadow_edge_r.name: Keen Edge
shadow_edge_r.text: Crit Damage +20 percentage points.

shadow_erode_n.name: Wear Down
shadow_erode_n.text: Every hit lowers the defense of the target by 2 % until the battle ends, up to 3 times. Cleanse removes it.

shadow_fever_n.name: Blood Fever
shadow_fever_n.text: After each turn in which it acts, its hits deal 2 % more damage, up to 5 times. Lasts until the battle ends.

shadow_finish_e.name: Finishing Blow
shadow_finish_e.text: +80 % damage against targets below 30 % HP.

shadow_finish_n.name: Finishing Blow
shadow_finish_n.text: +20 % damage against targets below 30 % HP.

shadow_frenzy_g.name: Hunting Frenzy
shadow_frenzy_g.text: If a target of its move ends up below 50 % HP or falls, it gets 35 % turn meter. Once per move.

shadow_frenzy_r.name: Hunting Frenzy
shadow_frenzy_r.text: If a target of its move ends up below 50 % HP or falls, it gets 22 % turn meter. Once per move.

shadow_fury_n.name: Grim Fury
shadow_fury_n.text: The less HP it has, the more damage its hits deal, up to 60 % more. At half HP it is half of that.

shadow_gamble_r.name: All or Nothing
shadow_gamble_r.text: Every hit rolls: 8 % chance of triple damage, otherwise 150 % or 50 % with equal odds.

shadow_giant_e.name: Giant Slayer
shadow_giant_e.text: Deals 30 % more damage to enemies with more max HP than itself, such as bosses.

shadow_lantern_e.name: Soul Lantern
shadow_lantern_e.text: Every fallen Ovaling and every fifth of HP a boss loses charges a soul, up to 3. Its next move uses them up and deals 50 % more damage per soul.

shadow_lifesteal_g.name: Bloodthirst
shadow_lifesteal_g.text: Heals by 100 % of the damage it deals.

shadow_lifesteal_n.name: Bloodthirst
shadow_lifesteal_n.text: Heals by 15 % of the damage it deals.

shadow_lifesteal_r.name: Bloodthirst
shadow_lifesteal_r.text: Heals by 38 % of the damage it deals.

shadow_linger_r.name: Long Shadow
shadow_linger_r.text: When it hits a target, its Attack Down, Defense Down, Speed Down and Heal Reduction last 1 turn longer. Each debuff only once. If the target has none of them, it gets Defense Down 30 % for 2 turns with a 25 % chance.

shadow_lurk_n.name: Night Eye
shadow_lurk_n.text: Every hit without a crit gives it +35 percentage points of Crit Chance until it crits again.

shadow_magpie_e.name: Magpie Claw
shadow_magpie_e.text: Every hit steals 1 % attack from the target until the battle ends and gives it to itself, up to 10 times.

shadow_mark_e.name: Death Mark
shadow_mark_e.text: After each move, it marks the hit enemy with the most HP. The whole team deals 6 % more damage to it while this Ovaling is alive.

shadow_moonstrike_g.name: Moon Strike
shadow_moonstrike_g.text: Every 2 turns of its own, all hits of its move are sure crits and ignore 30 % more defense.

shadow_oath_e.name: Blood Oath
shadow_oath_e.text: While it is alive, the whole team gets Crit Damage +15 percentage points.

shadow_offering_e.name: Blood Gift
shadow_offering_e.text: If it has more than half its HP, it sacrifices 3 % HP at the start of its turn. In return, the whole team has 25 % more attack for 1 turn.

shadow_pierce_e.name: Piercing Strike
shadow_pierce_e.text: Critical hits ignore 30 % of the target's defense.

shadow_pierce_n.name: Piercing Strike
shadow_pierce_n.text: Critical hits ignore 15 % of the target's defense.

shadow_plague_e.name: Plague Bite
shadow_plague_e.text: Every hit has a 30 % chance to poison for 2 turns (3 % HP per turn). Against bosses at most half its attack per turn.

shadow_plague_n.name: Plague Bite
shadow_plague_n.text: Every hit has a 10 % chance to poison for 2 turns (3 % HP per turn). Against bosses at most half its attack per turn.

shadow_predator_g.name: Conquest
shadow_predator_g.text: Every enemy that falls and every tenth of HP a boss loses gives it 8 % more attack until the battle ends, up to 5 times. If it falls, all of it is gone.

shadow_predator_r.name: Conquest
shadow_predator_r.text: Every enemy that falls and every tenth of HP a boss loses gives it 4 % more attack until the battle ends, up to 5 times. If it falls, all of it is gone.

shadow_revenge_e.name: Blood Vengeance
shadow_revenge_e.text: When it or an ally falls to an enemy hit, it strikes back at the attacker at once with 150 % strength and a sure crit. Once per enemy move for the whole team.

shadow_rot_g.name: Decay Breath
shadow_rot_g.text: While it is alive, all hits of its team ignore 12 % more defense.

shadow_rush_g.name: Death Rush
shadow_rush_g.text: Once per battle: a lethal hit leaves it standing with 1 HP. It takes its turn at once, all moves are ready, and in that turn it heals itself by 150 % of its damage.

shadow_scent_n.name: Scent of Blood
shadow_scent_n.text: While it is alive, the whole team deals 20 % more damage to enemies below 30 % HP.

shadow_shieldeater_r.name: Shield Eater
shadow_shieldeater_r.text: Its hits ignore 10 % defense. Against shields they count 50 % more: 100 damage takes 150 from the shield. Whatever is left then hits normally.

shadow_stalker_r.name: Highwayman
shadow_stalker_r.text: When an enemy uses an ability with a cooldown, there is a 60 % chance it strikes that enemy at once with a basic attack at 60 % strength. After that it waits until after its next turn.

shadow_step_g.name: Mist Step
shadow_step_g.text: 65 % chance to dodge every direct hit from an enemy. A dodged hit deals no damage and brings no effects.

shadow_step_r.name: Mist Step
shadow_step_r.text: 25 % chance to dodge every direct hit from an enemy. A dodged hit deals no damage and brings no effects.

shadow_surge_r.name: Blood Surge
shadow_surge_r.text: The first time its HP drops below 50 % and the first time below 25 %, it gets 30 % turn meter each time and 55 % more attack for 3 turns.

shadow_tear_r.name: Open Wound
shadow_tear_r.text: When it hits a bleeding target, the bleed strikes once more at once at 100 %. If the target is not bleeding yet, the first hit has a 25 % chance to cause Bleed for 2 turns. Once per move and target.

shadow_thorns_e.name: Thorn Skin
shadow_thorns_e.text: When an enemy hits it directly, the attacker takes 30 % of that damage back at once.

shadow_thorns_n.name: Thorn Skin
shadow_thorns_n.text: When an enemy hits it directly, the attacker takes 15 % of that damage back at once.

shadow_thread_g.name: Soul Thread
shadow_thread_g.text: Its critical hit binds the target to it for 2 turns. If the bound target hits an ally, it takes 35 % of that damage itself.

shadow_timeeater_e.name: Time Eater
shadow_timeeater_e.text: Each of its moves takes 7 % turn meter from every enemy hit. An enemy loses at most 30 % this way until its next turn. Against bosses it builds up and takes effect in steps of 5 %.

shadow_timeeater_n.name: Time Eater
shadow_timeeater_n.text: Each of its moves takes 3 % turn meter from every enemy hit. An enemy loses at most 30 % this way until its next turn. Against bosses it builds up and takes effect in steps of 5 %.

shadow_venom_e.name: Venom Lore
shadow_venom_e.text: +90 % damage against poisoned targets.

shadow_venom_g.name: Venom Lore
shadow_venom_g.text: +140 % damage against poisoned targets.

shadow_venom_r.name: Venom Lore
shadow_venom_r.text: +55 % damage against poisoned targets.

shadow_warp_g.name: Warp Mirror
shadow_warp_g.text: Each of its moves turns the newest buff of every enemy hit into its opposite, bosses only lose it. If it has none, it gets 10 % less speed for 2 turns, a boss for 1 turn.

shadow_wound_g.name: Wound Bite
shadow_wound_g.text: Its critical hits make the target bleed for 2 turns: 24 % of its attack as damage per turn.

shadow_wound_r.name: Wound Bite
shadow_wound_r.text: Its critical hits make the target bleed for 2 turns: 15 % of its attack as damage per turn.
